tool_description: Encrypt/Decrypt String/File Using these Algorithms (AES, DES, TripleDES, RC2, Rijndael).
name: Encryption-Api
title: Encryption-Api

api_list.name: DecryptString
api_list.description: Decrypt encrypted-text (base64-format) using input secret-key according to selected crypt-algorithm and cipher-mode (optional with CBC as default value).

required_parameters.name: cryptAlgorithm
required_parameters.description: Decryption Algorithm (AES [default], DES, TripleDES, RC2, Rijndael).

required_parameters.name: secretKey
required_parameters.description: Secret-Key string which will be used on decryption process, and it should be same secret-key which used on encryption process.

test_endpoint.result: Exception: The input is not a valid Base-64 string as it contains a non-base 64 character, more than two padding characters, or an illegal character among the padding characters.

result.description: Respons Result : Expected output with 'Success' status OR error description with 'Failure' status
